The snake has a slender, cylindrical body with visible scales that appear somewhat glossy but also textured. The coloration is primarily greyish-brown or olive-grey with darker mottling or banding, rather than uniform pinkish-brown. The head is distinct from the neck, with a visible eye and a pointed snout. A blurry foreground element (likely a branch or root) partially obscures the top of the frame.
